camp.title: Take a closer look at Camp Snooze
camp.why: You want daily group coaching and your baby is within Camp's five-month-plus age range. Camp brings a personalised plan, daily roll call and a private forum into two weeks of support.

snooze.title: Explore flexible support with Snooze
snooze.why: You want guidance you can use around your own day. Snooze brings support from Sally and her team together with resources you can return to.

young.title: Start with support for your baby's age
young.why: Camp starts from five months. Sally's age-specific resources and Snooze support are a place to explore what is available for your family now.

private.title: Explore individual support
private.why: You would prefer support focused on your family. The consultation page explains Sally's individual support options so you can compare them with Camp.

talk.title: Talk through your questions before choosing
talk.why: You would like more clarity before deciding on a support format. Bring the questions below to the team so you can understand how the support would fit your family.
